text:
Priya S.: Hey team — Sapphire asked for a focused 48‑hour stress sprint next Tue/Wed. Goal: validate steady-state 150 qps with p50 < 80ms and p99 < 350ms, plus recurring microbursts to 1.2k qps for 30s every 10m. Need: test plan, recommended infra (Dedicated vs burst), and a quick delta on pricing for sustained vs burst margin. Can eng own the run + results writeup?

Dmitri: Yep I can run it. Quick sanity checks: what model and max tokens per request? That changes batching/kv cache behavior.

Priya S.: Model is open-llama-7b-quant (8-bit) with prompt ~150 tokens, expected generation ~60 tokens. Client will hit with 3s client-side timeout for microbursts. They care about cold starts too.

Ava: For that shape, KV cache per session is small. Main cost driver will be concurrency and batching. Recommended starting point: Dedicated pool of 4xA10G (or equivalent A100-40 for headroom). We can simulate microbursts with our load harness.

Jin: I'll sketch a runbook:
1) Provision test cluster in us-west-2 (4xA10G) + loadgen nodes (c5.4xlarge)
2) Warm models with prefix cache load (script: load_warm.sh) for 20m
3) Run steady-state at 150 qps for 2h for metrics baseline
4) Inject scheduled microbursts: 1.2k qps for 30s every 10m for 6 hours
5) Capture traces + per-token cost, p50/p90/p99 latencies, GPU util, queue length

Use this wrk-style driver (we use an internal harness but here's the simplified command):
```
./loadgen --target https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \n  --concurrency 200 --qps 1200 --duration 30s --payload template.json
```
(we'll run many short jobs to shape bursts)

Dmitri: A few test notes:
- For steady 150 qps we expect batching to kick in and yield ~55ms p50 on A10G quant path.
- Microbursts will saturate GPU scheduling; expect p99 spikes if queueing > 200.
- If they need p99 < 350ms under bursts, we'll likely need either more GPUs or enable aggressive batching/cold-prefix cache.

Priya S.: Sales asks for pricing delta: what does Dedicated 4xA10G monthly vs on-demand burst add look like? Need a ballpark to tell customer before contract review.

Ava: Ballpark: Dedicated commit (4xA10G) ~ $XXk/mo (include reserved infra + platform fee). If they want occasional bursts to 1.2k qps we can do Dedicated + burst capacity on hosted cluster — expect ~20–35% extra on top of unit cost depending on burst duration. I'll add exact numbers after we run the baseline and get effective tokens/sec per GPU.

Jin: Operational checklist for the sprint:
- @deploy-bot spin up redwood-load-gen-03 in us-west-2 and attach to test route
- Create a canary route that falls back to a lower-capacity variant if tail latency > 1s
- Add perf dashboard (route: sapphire-poc/bench) with p50/p90/p99, tokens/sec, and cost-per-1M-tokens

deploy-bot: ✅ cluster redwood-load-gen-03 provisioned in us-west-2. Model image: open-llama-7b-quant:v2. Warm node pool ready.

Dmitri: I'll run a short smoke now to verify harness and then schedule the main window Wed 02:00–08:00 UTC (low traffic). Priya, can you confirm Sapphire approves that window?

Priya S.: Confirmed with customer; Wed 02:00–08:00 UTC works. Also looping in legal for the security questionnaire item: they asked if logs contain PII. Answer: we redact user content at ingress and store minimal metadata — Jin can paste the exact language for the questionnaire.

Jin: Security blurb for the questionnaire: "We do not persist PII in logs by default. Request payloads are redacted at the edge; audit logs retain anonymized request IDs and routing metadata only. For customers requiring full separation, use Private deployment with customer-controlled KMS and audit logs."

Ava: Next steps: Dmitri runs the smoke tonight, full run Wed 02:00. I'll prepare a results template (spreadsheet + short writeup) that includes: topology, commands, steady-state numbers, burst behavior, recommendations (scale, batching, quant/FP16 swap), and pricing delta. Expect first draft by Thu EOD.

Priya S.: Awesome — thanks everyone. Please drop the run artifacts and perf dashboard link in this thread after Wed. :rocket:
